child.text:
[{"insert":"Back Squat Progression

The back squat comes back this week at 15 reps per set.   The highest rep prescription of the cycle. High rep squats at RPE 7 to 9 demand both strength and the ability to sustain output under accumulating fatigue. Brace hard at the top of every rep before descending. The goal is to hold consistent depth and speed across all three sets even as the legs fatigue.
"}]
